title: Stop hook gate: descent receipt, format strike, stop-menu and contentless-completion blocks
desc: The Claude Stop hook (wkharness-claude-stop.ps1) and its check registry: refuses a turn that ends on a stop-menu offer, a contentless completion, a missing descent receipt, or a format recite. The only hook seeing the model's own composed text -- and per-family, so it does NOT fire for agy or codex, which is why descent gates like the gc-tmp purge moved onto a TOOL CALL (an edit to HANDOFF.md) instead. Cluster: harness-stop-guard-howto (field contract, check inventory, wk-stop-test), harness-stop-guard-ref (dated design history).
steps: STOP REPORT SHAPE: ONE prose paragraph (not bullets) naming one core skill id (never -howto or -ref in prose -- write 'the handoff skill' or a Korean word instead; naming a tier fires skill-tier-gate; example: write 'the reflexes skill' when citing commanded-root-reflexes, never write commanded-root-reflexes-howto in prose), evidence line directly under it as PLAIN TEXT -- the cited file MUST be read via a tool call in this session, not only loaded as system context; road: run wkappbot file read PATH --keep quote or wkappbot skill read ID before the stop report paragraph that names it (cite-refused:not-read fires when the file was only in a system-reminder and never fetched as a tool call; worked example 2026-10-13: the global CLAUDE.md was only system-reminder context -- running wkappbot file read on it in the same turn as the stop reply cleared the gate) -- a backtick-wrapped line fails keepPat and silently goes to paragraph body not keep field; skill-keep-gate fires. Road: pick the quote first, write the paragraph so 2+ quote words (4+ letters) appear in it above the keep line (skill-keep-relevance-gate fires if they do not); write bare: wkappbot skill read ID --keep 'quote', then the Reflex-healing paragraph with two evidence lines. Every bullet line counts as its own paragraph and fires skill-ref-gate. Road: inline any PREDICT or status note inside the cited paragraph itself, never as a separate block (example: 'PREDICT: sectors return gaps -- dispatched per on-load, sector A surveys gaps'). EDIT ROAD: write old/new txt under .tmp, wkappbot file edit --old-file .tmp/old.txt --new-file .tmp/new.txt FILE (harness:safe bypasses busy-fleet); self-test from canonical; git commit -- FILE; wkpush.sh -C REPO -m FILE. A tally of test numbers (4/4, 93/93) stays inside one prose sentence, never a bullet list (2026-10-13: a four-bullet tally was refused as four uncited paragraphs). Open with the cited paragraph itself, zero preamble. //why:prose paragraph shape governs every stop reply-sonnet //why:will follow: stop report shape one prose-haiku //why:shape governs every stop reply this turn-sonnet //why:will follow: stop gate report format //why:open cited paragraph zero preamble format

REFLEX-HEALING SHAPE: last paragraph starts Reflex-healing, two evidence lines directly under it: first wkappbot file read OFFICIAL_MD --keep quote, then wkappbot skill read CORE_ID --keep quote. Name ONE concrete thing from this turn. The branch skill (CORE_ID) must govern the named mistake: cite the skill that covers letter-posture if that blocked (road: wkappbot skill read claude-session-handoff-howto), not harness-stop-guard itself. //why:will follow: reflex-healing shape last paragraph-sonnet //why:will follow: reflex-healing shape: last paragraph-sonnet //why:will follow: reflex-healing shape last paragraph-sonnet //why:reflex-healing needs file-read then skill-read under it //why:reflex healing shape two evidence lines required //why:file read first skill read second order

QUOTE SIMILARITY GATE: each evidence line --keep quote must be DISTINCT within the session response -- no quote phrase may be reused across different paragraphs, even with reworded context. WHEN: writing multiple paragraphs, each citing a different skill. HOW: before pasting the next wkappbot skill read line, verify its --keep fragment is semantically fresh relative to prior evidence lines in this very response, not a rephrase of an earlier quote. The keep-relevance-gate requires topic-word overlap between the quote and its paragraph context; the similarity-gate enforces that the quotes themselves do not overlap with one another across paragraphs, forming a GREEDY ANTISET rather than a synonymous pool. WHY: measured 2026-10-13, a response citing the same concept from the same skill (e.g. both quoting building/testing/deployment steps to distinct paragraphs about building/testing/deploying) failed the similarity gate because a 4+ letter token appeared in both quotes despite the sentences being distinct; the gate blocks even partial-token overlap in quote text across evidence lines within one response, forcing a new sentence for each paragraph. ROAD: move the --keep window (retry with a fresh sentence nearby) or substitute a DIFFERENT skill id (if citing identical subject matter across paragraphs, the second paragraph should cite a sibling skill, not the same skill twice), or condense multiple paragraphs into one if they share the same topic. //why:gate blocks partial token overlap across evidence lines //why:gg macOS workflow citation validation complete
